body:
Follow-on product scope — estate-9ec02b70e5f0.

On current main `55fe1e0a3c4ad85e1065f295e49d44722c3be32b` (tree `7c1bd0a858a3fda82a4d5e69076801ae65a73ea1`), the landed #34/#40 reader provides feedback as JSON. I am adding an explicit native `canvaspilot export-feedback COURSE ASSIGNMENT --out feedback.html` command so a student can retain a readable, printable local feedback sheet with the supplied rubric, comments and attempt context.

Isolated scope: a small feedback HTML formatter, additive CLI parser/dispatch wiring, focused tests and usage. The existing `CanvasAPI.submission_feedback` reader and feedback projection remain authoritative. Current pagination #35, calendar identity #43/#45, auth/client/session broker, MCP and bundle owners retain their regions. No grading total, grade applicability, commenter role or missing assessment will be inferred.

Qualification will exercise the actual CLI and GET reader through disposable authored loopback responses, then inspect the produced standalone file offline. It will cover zero versus unknown values, prior-attempt warnings, distinct rubric display flags, literal Unicode/markup comments and failure/no-overwrite behavior. No school account, live broker, grading/submission write or deployment is involved. Root centralizes publication; implementation and independent receiving remain separate. Source and evidence will be qualified before integration.
